turns.question: What was the median gap in hours between consecutive orders of the same customer in September 2026, counting only customers with at least two orders?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median gap in hours between a customer's consecutive orders, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Orders (orders_total), which counts all orders placed, and Repeat customers (repeat_customers), which counts customers with two or more orders; neither measures the time between orders, and no query was run, so no freshness statement applies.
